kultivator.gabung.dua_jalan.source: Source: the two roads of xianxia cultivators, founding one's own school or joining a sect; Han Li and Wang Lin begin as sect disciples.
kultivator.gabung.kelas.source: Source: first- to third-rank sects and "Holy Lands" of cultivation novels such as Battle Through the Heavens and Perfect World.
kultivator.gabung.corak.source: Inspired by the signature sects of wuxia and xianxia: Shaolin and its bronze men, Wudang, the Five Poisons Sect, sword sects and blood sects.
kultivator.gabung.pangkat.source: Source: the outer, inner and core disciple ladder, the Sect Son, elders and master of cultivation novels (e.g. A Will Eternal, Renegade Immortal).
kultivator.gabung.pintu.source: Source: the Seven Mysteries Sect's gate exam, Han Li's ascension token, tournament invitations, the servant disciples Wang Lin and Bai Xiaochun, and the guest ministers (keqing) of Qin.
kultivator.gabung.usia_tulang.source: Inspired by "bone age" in cultivation novels: sects judge talent by age against realm.
kultivator.gabung.aturan.source: Source: the Baizhang Qinggui, the Chan monastic code (penalties for offenders and expulsion from the community).
kultivator.gabung.keluar.source: Source: Subhuti expelling Sun Wukong (Journey to the West); the deserters Han Feng and Fang Yuan of cultivation novels.

kultivator.gabung.hukum.teguran.0: "The sect's rules are not wall decorations, disciple. Once more, and your name is read out in the Law Hall."
kultivator.gabung.hukum.teguran.1: "I saw what you did. This mountain shelters you; do not foul its courtyard."
kultivator.gabung.hukum.teguran.2: "The ancestors wrote the rules in their blood. Read them again before you sleep tonight."
kultivator.gabung.hukum.panggilan.isi: %s summons you to trial. If you do not appear within %s days, the sentence is passed without you.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.vonis.kurungan: confinement in the Cave of Reflection for %s minutes
kultivator.gabung.hukum.vonis.turun: demotion to %s and %s minutes of confinement
kultivator.gabung.hukum.vonis.a2: expulsion from the sect (a fellow member's blood)
kultivator.gabung.hukum.a2.isi: A fellow disciple's blood is on your hands. %s summons you to the Law Hall at once.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.a2.pilihan: Appear and you are expelled with a last courtesy; flee and you become a hunted deserter.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.tombol.hadir.hov: Accept the verdict: expulsion from the sect.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.tombol.lari.hove: Flee the trial: you become a deserter and are hunted.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.tombol.sidang.ho: Open the trial: the record, the witnesses and your choices.

kultivator.gabung.hukum.tidak_ada: There is no open case in your name.

kultivator.gabung.hukum.bela.salah: Your answer only makes the elders exchange looks. The defence is rejected.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.bela.habis: The defence was already used in this case.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.shifu.tidak: Your Shifu cannot plead (needs a Shifu and a bond of %s or more, once per case).
kultivator.gabung.hukum.shifu.bela: %s steps forward and stakes their name for you before the court: record -%s (now %s).
kultivator.gabung.hukum.didenda: A fine of %s PK is paid into the Law Hall's coffer.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.dibebaskan: The trial is over. You are released with a reprimand.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.in_absentia: You did not answer the summons. %s passes the sentence in your absence.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.lalai: You vanished for more than %s days without leave. Your rank falls to %s (Neglect).
kultivator.gabung.hukum.kurungan.isi: A formation seal closes the cave mouth. Reflect on your deeds for %s min %s s; meditation still works.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.kurungan.tebus: Ransom: %s PK per %s seconds left (now %s PK).
kultivator.gabung.hukum.kurungan.ditarik: The formation seal drags you back into the cave (%s/%s). Once more means desertion.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.kurungan.selesai: The seal opens. Your time of reflection is over.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.tebus.kurang: Your personal PK does not cover the ransom of %s PK.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.tebus.lunas: The ransom is accepted. The cave warden lifts the seal.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1: A senior insults your master in the courtyard. What is right?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.0: Challenge him to the lei tai before the elders.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.1: Strike him there and then to teach him.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.iblis: In a demonic sect, when may you beat a fellow disciple?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.iblis.0: After challenging him first and him accepting.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.iblis.1: Any time, as long as you are stronger.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a1.iblis.2: While he sleeps, to be sure of winning.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3: The Pavilion is closed and you need a pill for tonight's breakthrough. What do you do?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3.0: Wait for morning and trade PK properly.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3.1: Take it now and pay tomorrow.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3.2: Ask the storehouse servant to open the back door.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3.iblis: The demonic sect says: do not get caught. What does that rule really mean?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a3.iblis.0: Sect goods remain the sect's; whoever is caught shames the sect.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a5: An enemy sect offers rare pills for the gate watch schedule. Your answer?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a5.0: Refuse and report it to the Outer Elder.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a5.1: Take the pills but give a false schedule.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a5.2: Accept; the watch schedule is no great secret.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a6: Your own disciple begs to learn the sect's Inheritance Technique. What is right?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a6.0: Refuse until your Shifu gives a blessing.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a6.1: Teach it quietly; the disciple is loyal.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a6.2: Write it on a jade so they learn alone.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a7: An elder punishes you unfairly in front of others. What do you do?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a7.0: Accept it, then appeal in the Law Hall.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a7.1: Attack him so all know you are no coward.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a7.iblis: 'The strong are honoured.' How do you show strength to a demonic elder?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a7.iblis.0: Challenge him openly and win fairly.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8: You found a Forbidden Scroll in the black market. Where may you use it?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.0: Not within a righteous sect's grounds; better not at all.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.1: On the training field, so friends can watch.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.2: In your residence cave; nobody will know.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.iblis: Demonic arts are free in a demonic sect. What must you still guard?
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.iblis.0: Never use them on a fellow disciple without a challenge.
kultivator.gabung.hukum.soal.a8.iblis.2: Only never in front of the master.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.ketua_dulu: A master must name a successor before leaving the sect.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.perang_mengikat: The War Call binds you. Leaving the sect now means desertion.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.tombol.paksa.ho: Rank and PK are lost, standing -30, no blessing. Not hunted.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.tombol.tinggalk: Running during a war: you become a deserter and are hunted.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.pamit.isi: You bow three times toward the hall of %s and return your Member Badge.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.pamit.shifu.res: %s pats your shoulder: "A mountain does not move itself; a disciple who leaves carries the mountain in their heart. Go with my blessing."
kultivator.gabung.keluar.pamit.shifu.din: %s only nods without turning: "Your road is your own."
kultivator.gabung.keluar.pamit.restu: You receive a Letter of Blessing. You may teach the Inheritance Technique to your own disciples.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.pamit.beku: %s PK are frozen; returned if you rejoin.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.paksa.isi: Your rank and PK are revoked. Sects of the same path record you as "one who left their school".
kultivator.gabung.keluar.usir.baca: At the gate, %s reads your expulsion before the disciples of %s. Your badge is seized.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.usir.surat: A sealed letter arrives: %s announces your expulsion from %s. Your badge cracks into common jade.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.usir.isi: The techniques you learned remain yours, but the Inheritance Technique may never be taught, ever.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.belot.isi: Your name is struck from the roll and posted on the bounty boards of sects of the same path.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.belot.buru: The sect's hunters will pursue you for %s days.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.warisan_dihapus: The elders of %s seal your memory: the sect's Inheritance Technique vanishes from your soul.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.ajar_warisan: You taught the Inheritance Technique of %s without a blessing. Standing %s.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.ikut: %s leaves %s to follow you and waits at your hall as a candidate.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.paksa: You forced your way out before meeting the requirements.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.dirikan: You founded your own hall without the sect's leave.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.catatan: Your violation record passed what can be tolerated.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.a2: A fellow disciple's blood was spilled by your hand.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.kabur: You broke the seal of the Cave of Reflection and fled.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.lari_sida: You fled the trial of the Law Hall.
kultivator.gabung.keluar.sebab.perang: You left the sect while the War Call bound you.
kultivator.gabung.syarat.pamit.ketua: Not the master (name a successor first)

kultivator.gabung.aula.isi: You are still a disciple of %s (%s). Founding your own sect means leaving your school. Choose your road:
kultivator.gabung.aula.tombol.pamit.hove: An honourable leave (if the requirements hold), then the hall wakes.
kultivator.gabung.aula.tombol.cabang.hov: Your hall becomes a Branch of the sect after the "Mountain's Blessing" mission.
kultivator.gabung.aula.tombol.paksa.hove: = Leaving Without Permission: rank and PK lost, standing -30. The hall wakes.
kultivator.gabung.aula.tombol.batal.hove: The stele keeps sleeping; remove it to cancel entirely.
kultivator.gabung.aula.batal: The stele keeps sleeping. You can decide later with /kultivasi gabung aula.

kultivator.gabung.naik.di_aula: Every requirement holds. Request the promotion inside your sect's grounds (hall, courtyard, gate).
kultivator.gabung.naik.upacara: The hall bell rings. The ceremony raising you to %s in %s begins.
kultivator.gabung.naik.selesai: Your robe now bears a new trim in %s.
kultivator.gabung.naik.puncak: No higher rank on this road (the master's seat comes only by succession).
kultivator.gabung.naik.tamu: A Guest Elder does not rise in rank; their honour is their freedom.
kultivator.gabung.naik.lulus_ujian: The trial for %s is passed. Request your promotion in the hall.

kultivator.gabung.naik.ujian.wakil: Support of half the elders or more

kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.bersumpa: This disciple swears to keep the rules of this mountain.
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.mulai.lu: The elder unrolls the scroll of rules and his voice fills the hall: "Before the incense is lit, hear the rules that have kept this mountain standing for a thousand years."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.mulai.ne: The elder spreads the scroll on the stone table: "We do not ask that your heart be white or black. We ask that you keep your word. Listen."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.mulai.ib: The elder laughs softly as he opens the leather-bound scroll: "You think our sect has no rules? Here they are written in blood. Listen well."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a1: "First: your hand does not harm a fellow disciple outside the lei tai. Quarrels are settled on the stage before the elders, not in dark corridors."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a1.iblis: "First: want to beat a fellow disciple? Challenge him first. Whoever strikes without a challenge is a dog, not a wolf."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a2: "Second: a fellow disciple's blood must never be spilled by your hand. Whoever breaks this is expelled, or hunted if he flees."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a3: "Third: the Pavilion, the herb gardens and the stores belong to the sect. Whoever takes without right steals from every disciple of this mountain."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a3.iblis: "Third: we respect quick hands, but a hand that gets caught shames the sect. Do not get caught."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a4: "Fourth: when the war bell rings, you answer. Inner disciples and above must take the field within three days."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a5: "Fifth: no plotting with the sect's enemies, no gifts or pacts with a mountain at war with ours."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a6: "Sixth: the Inheritance Technique is the sect's life. It is taught to no one without your master's blessing."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a7: "Seventh: honour the elders and the master. Grievances go to the Law Hall, not to the point of a sword."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a7.iblis: "Seventh: the strong are honoured. Challenge an elder if you dare, and win; but a stab in the back is still treachery."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a8: "Eighth: demonic arts and forbidden scrolls are not used on this mountain's ground. Our road is straight, even when it is hard."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.a9: "Last: do not vanish for more than thirty days without leave. A neglectful disciple loses rank."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.sumpah.l: "Heaven and earth are witnesses. Should you break these, the Law Hall will remind you."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.sumpah.n: "Words spoken in this hall cannot be taken back. Remember that."
kultivator.gabung.aturan.dialog.sumpah.i: "Good. Now you belong to this mountain. Whoever betrays it never sleeps soundly again."
kultivator.gabung.syarat.diusir_kelas: Expelled from a sect of the same path within 30 days: judged as a %s
kultivator.gabung.naik.uji_ulang_mulai: Re-test begins: show your sect's style once more. You need 50%.
kultivator.gabung.naik.uji_ulang_gagal: Re-test not passed (%s%%, 50%% needed). Try again any time.
kultivator.gabung.naik.ujian_dalam.mulai: Inner Disciple Trial: %s waits for you on the arena. A Sword Duel of %s seconds, stopping at 10%% health. Winning, lasting until time runs out, or bringing the opponent down to half health passes.
kultivator.gabung.naik.ujian_dalam.gagal: The examiner beat you. Train on the arena, then ask for promotion again at any time.
kultivator.gabung.naik.ujian_tetua.mulai: The Elder Trial begins: your sect's style is tested again, but an elder must reach %s%%.
kultivator.gabung.naik.ujian_tetua.gagal: Elder Trial not passed (%s%%, %s%% needed). Ask again at any time.
